comment: The discussion characterises the OpenHIE interoperability layer as a single point of entry and associates it with concentration of control, failure, and procurement bottlenecks. OpenHIE describes logical roles that can be implemented through different products and deployment patterns. The comparison may therefore be unnecessarily reductive.

public.text: The discussion characterises the OpenHIE interoperability layer as a single point of entry and associates it with concentration of control, failure, and procurement bottlenecks. OpenHIE describes logical roles that can be implemented through different products and deployment patterns. The comparison may therefore be unnecessarily reductive.
public.suggestedRevision: Present OpenHIE more neutrally. Distinguish the logical interoperability layer from a particular centralised deployment and cite country evidence where central implementations produced the stated problems.
